calendar.julianNote: On the Old (Julian) calendar, today's liturgical date is thirteen days behind the civil date. Both are shown above.
calendar.reckoningsNote: Two reckonings are available via the toggle above. The default, New (Revised Julian), is used by the Ecumenical Patriarchate of Constantinople and the majority of canonical Orthodox jurisdictions for fixed feasts. The Old (Julian) option is used by the Russian, Serbian, Jerusalem, and Athonite traditions, and runs thirteen days behind for fixed feasts. Pascha and its moveable cycle are shared between both, computed by the Julian-based algorithm common to every canonical Orthodox church.

prayers.anthem.intro1: The English Prayer Rope Anthem is a contemporary Orthodox chant for the prayer rope, sung knot by knot as the rope is told. Verse by verse it lifts the rope's short prayers: to the Holy Trinity, to the Lord Jesus, to the Most Holy Theotokos, to St John the Baptist, and to all the saints and holy angels, each closing on the same refrain.
prayers.anthem.intro2: No single author is recorded for it; the anthem spread across the Orthodox world. It is offered here in English, French, and Arabic. Choose a language, loop it softly, and follow the words below.
prayers.akathists.title: The Akathists.
prayers.akathists.intro: The Akathist is the long-form hymn the Church sings standing throughout, “not seated” (a-kathisma). Thirteen Kontakia alternate with twelve Ikoi, sung in full at stations along the Church year, and in pieces, quietly, in personal rule.
prayers.akathists.note: More akathists are being typeset (Christ, the saints). If you can help, write to team@purify.app.
prayers.hoursIndex.title: Standing through the day.
prayers.hoursIndex.intro: The Hours sanctify the daylight at its natural breaks. They are short by design, five to eight minutes, held together by three appointed Psalms, a Troparion, and a dismissal.
prayers.hoursIndex.note: Each hour carries its three appointed Psalms in full, in Brenton's public-domain Septuagint translation, with the fixed Troparion and dismissal of the hour.
